note: Adapted from the entry of Chhotani (1997) (209. Malaysiocapritermes dakshinae Chhotani and Ferry, Figs. 177, 178; the original gives “In press. Chhotani and Ferry, Ann. Entom.”), originally in English; synonymy, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated. The book uses the genus name Malaysiocapritermes, whereas the site uses Procapritermes dakshinae Chhotani & Ferry, 1995; the type locality (Kerala, in the vicinity of Arippal village) agrees, and the two are judged to be the same species under a different generic combination. The original records the alate as “Unknown”, so that caste is absent. In the worker section the original repeats a sentence on antennal colour (“antennae pale yellowish brown; antennae pale yellow”), which is merged in the translation.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown; antennae pale brown; mandibles nearly black; labrum pale yellowish white; thorax and abdomen pale yellow. Head and body rather densely hairy, with long and short hairs. Total length 6.70–7.20 mm. Head capsule subrectangular; the sides weakly convex; width slightly more than 3/4 of the head length to the mandibular base (length to mandibular base 1.90–2.00 mm, maximum width 1.40–1.53 mm); the frons slopes forward gradually but rather steeply; the coronal suture is evident only near the posterior margin of the head. Fontanelle small, circular, connected to a fine brown tube; situated at about 3/4 of the head length from the posterior margin (fontanelle distance/head length index 0.775–0.805). Antennae 14-segmented; the segments long and slender; segment 3 longer than segment 2; segment 4 shortest. Labrum slightly asymmetrical; anterior margin deeply incurved; apex pointed; the sides widening posteriorly and angulate at the posterior 1/4 (length 0.33–0.35 mm, width 0.33–0.38 mm). Mandibles long, asymmetrical (left mandible length 2.10 mm, right 2.05–2.10 mm); slightly longer than the head (mandible length/head length index 1.05); apex pointed. Postmentum short, rod-shaped (length 0.90–1.00 mm, maximum width 0.40–0.43 mm, waist width 0.25–0.26 mm, waist width/maximum width index 0.60–0.63). Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.38 mm, width 0.78–0.80 mm); the middle of the anterior lobe deeply notched. Tibial apical spurs 3:2:2, the dorsal spur of the fore tibia minute and stump-like, sometimes indistinct.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head, postclypeus and legs pale yellowish brown; antennae pale yellow; thorax paler than the head; abdomen semi-transparent, the gut contents visible through the integument. Head and body rather densely hairy. Total length 4.00–4.10 mm. Head subcircular (length to the clypeal margin 1.03–1.10 mm, length to the mandibular base 0.70–0.77 mm, maximum width 0.85–0.90 mm). Fontanelle plate oval, translucent, rather large (length 0.10–0.12 mm, width 0.06–0.07 mm). Antennae 14-segmented; segment 3 shorter than segment 2. Postclypeus arched, with long and short hairs; less than half as long as wide (length 0.17 mm, width 0.46 mm). Mandibles each with one apical tooth and 2 marginal teeth, the apical tooth larger than the first marginal tooth (morphology as in the original figure). Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior lobe without a notch. Legs slender, hairy; fore tibia swollen; tibial apical spurs 2:2:2, the dorsal spur of the fore tibia indistinct.
